QUOTE: When `hasSearch` is true it renders `<NavigationSearch {...searchProps} hideHeader theme topStyle ref={ref} />` at around line 128.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says NavigationHeader is a forwardRef and passes the ref to NavigationSearch only when `hasSearch` is true. That implies the ref goes nowhere when it is false. It never says the ref is attached to nothing, but the conditional-rendering mechanism is stated.
